policy: Only production_daemons are installed and enabled by the Ubuntu package. The former prototype daemons (walletd, presenced, contextd) were removed in UDVIKLINGSPLAN F1.2; a new prototype daemon must be listed here and must not be represented as a production service.
ipc_connects_policy: UDVIKLINGSPLAN F1c.3: each daemon may create only its own socket in /run/eira and connect only to the daemons listed here. The AppArmor profiles must match; tests/test_daemon_isolation.py checks both against the code's IpcClient calls.
